The '''Cel Amiin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cel Amiin]].
